title: Tunable fcc/hcp NiRu alloy nanoparticles anchored on hierarchical N-doped carbon nanosheets for enhanced hydrogen evolution

The Ni5Ru@N-C with dual-phase fcc/hcp NiRu alloy was synthesized via an iminodiacetonitrile-assisted strategy, delivering outstanding catalytic performance for alkaline hydrogen evolution.
